📚 Hard vocab word #140: LAUDATORY

laudatory (adjective): expressing praise.

✅ In a sentence: The film received laudatory reviews from nearly every critic.
✅ Similar: admiring, complimentary, praising
✅ Remember it: Related to "laud" (to praise) and "laudable."
